exposure: cleavage stage vs. blastocyst stage embryo transfer
cohort: 1,583 offspring born after IVF treatment and 5,874 offspring conceived spontaneously
finding: IVF treatment was associated with an increased risk of offspring neoplasm, particularly for those who were transferred as fresh embryos, at an earlier embryotic stage (cleavage stage), or after three or more aspirated oocytes.
mod_finding: IVF treatment is associated with offspring neoplasm risk, and the risk was greater among offspring who were returned as fresh embryos, at an earlier embryotic stage (cleavage stage), or after three or more aspirated oocytes.
